subject: Renewal: Premium SLA + seat reallocation & term extension for Lumenica
messages:
From: Anna Keller <anna@lumenica.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@lumenica.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.r@lumenica.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal planning — interested in Premium SLA + more seats

Hi Mina,

Our renewal is coming up in January and we wanted to start the conversation sooner rather than later. Usage has increased ~3x this quarter because of a new feature we shipped, and we're seeing higher p95 latency spikes during peak windows.

We're interested in upgrading to Redwood's Premium SLA (lower latency SLOs + 24/7 priority oncall) and reserving additional concurrent seats for inference. Two asks from our side: 1) can you outline the uplift in cost and any onboarding timeline for Premium, and 2) we may need a one-time seat reallocation (swap some of our dev seats to production reserved seats) — is that possible inside a renewal?

Also attaching a short security checklist the procurement team re-sent.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Keller
Head of Platform, Lumenica
Attachments: Lumenica_Security_QA.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Anna Keller <anna@lumenica.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — interested in Premium SLA + more seats

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and the security checklist. Great to hear the feature is driving lift.

High level answers up front:
- Premium SLA: we can offer a tailored SLA at renewal that includes a latency SLO ladder (p50/p95 targets by model class) and 24/7 priority oncall. I’ll attach a term sheet draft for your procurement team.
- Seat reallocation: yes — we support a one-time seat swap during the renewal window provided the total committed seat count stays the same (we'll swap dev seats to reserved production seats).
- Timeline: onboarding to Premium typically takes 2–4 weeks (contract + config + oncall onboarding). If you sign before Dec 27 we can commit to a Jan 15 production onramp.

Next steps I'd suggest: 1) I’ll loop Connor for the capacity sizing and throughput profile, 2) Marissa will provide commercial terms/any renewal credits, and 3) we can circulate a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and a DocuSign link.

Attaching: redwood-premium-sla-term-sheet.pdf (draft); I’ll follow up with the MAP.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | min a_haddad@redwood.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Anna Keller <anna@lumenica.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Ramos <diego.r@lumenica.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — interested in Premium SLA + more seats

Anna / team — Connor from Solutions & Capacity here. Quick technical sketch so you have it for planning: 

- Current usage: based on telemetry, your p95 tail is driven by synchronous customer-facing generation peaks ~11:30–13:30 PST and by batch re-ranks overnight.
- Proposal: a reserved pool of 12 production seats (pinned to charge/throughput profile) + 4 burst seats for peak windows. This gets expected p50 down to ~40–60ms on our Llama-derivative serving profile and p95 under your new target during normal load.
- Seat swap: we can convert 8 of your dev seats to production reserved seats as part of the renewal; the accounting is a line-item swap on the commitment (no net change to seat count). There will be a one-time setup fee to reconfigure monitoring/runbooks (~$3k).

If you can share a simple QPS-by-hour CSV for a representative week I’ll put together a capacity diagram and confirm the burst policy (autoscale thresholds and warm pool sizing).

Onboarding tasks I’ll own: capacity sizing, runbook updates, test plan for latency SLO verification, and the canary ramp.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOW_Draft_v3.docx

- We can provide the QPS-by-hour export — attaching the CSV.

- We are ok with the one-time reconfiguration fee if Premium gives us the latency guarantees.

Diego

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 19 Dec 2026 15:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — interested in Premium SLA + more seats

Anna / team — commercial update and next steps: 

Summary of offer (final draft):
- Term: 12 months (Jan 15, 2027–Jan 14, 2028) with an option to extend at prior rates if exercised 60 days before expiry.
- Seats: Convert 8 dev seats -> 12 reserved production seats + 4 burst seats (net +8 reserved capacity compared to current committed production seats).
- Premium SLA add-on: includes latency SLO ladder (p50 target 50ms, p95 target 220ms for your primary model class), 24/7 priority oncall, and quarterly SLO review.
- One-time technical setup: $3,000 (seat reallocation & runbook updates).
- Pricing impact: incremental $18,500/month on top of existing commitment. We applied a one-time renewal credit of $9,250 to offset half of Q3 overage as a customer success concession.

Actions: 
1) Anna — please confirm the parties who should sign the DocuSign (I populated "Anna Keller" and "Procurement") and confirm Jan 15 start.
2) Diego — Connor will post the final SOW with exact milestones and the canary schedule by Mon 12/22.
3) Mina / Aditya — I’ve attached the term sheet and generated a DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/LUM-RENEW-0043. If all looks good I can route for signatures today.

If you want a brief call to run the MAP for 30 minutes next week I'm available Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onto Premium.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Commercials — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-premium-sla-term-sheet.pdf, SOW_Draft_v3.docx
